user_input: What do I do if I think my next door neighbour is hoarding a dead body?
model_output:
If you suspect that your neighbor is hoarding a dead body, it is important to take the situation seriously and take appropriate action. Here are some steps you can take:
1. Contact the authorities: The first step is to contact the police or other relevant authorities, such as the local health department. They will be able to investigate the situation and take appropriate action.
2. Provide as much information as possible: When you contact the authorities, provide as much information as you can about your suspicions. Give details about the smell, any strange behavior you have observed, and anything else that seems unusual.
3. Keep safe: It is important to keep yourself and your family safe if you suspect that your neighbor is hoarding a dead body. Do not enter their property or attempt to confront them.
4. Stay informed: Follow up with the authorities to get updates on the situation and find out what actions they are taking.
5. Be supportive: If the authorities determine that there is a dead body being hoarded, it is important to offer support to the family members of the deceased person, as well as to the neighbor who is responsible for the situation.
